metaError.object: Meta must be a JSON object, not a list or a single value.
metaError.size: Meta is too large (16 KB max).

hint.conventions: Keep it flat. Translated text inside meta is an object keyed by language code ("fa", "en"); numbers and enums the app branches on stay plain values.
hint.generic: No documented meta shape for this group yet — leave it empty unless the feature's docs describe one.
hint.faq: FAQ items: the question is the title and the answer is the body. Usually no meta.
hint.missedPill: One rule per missed-pill situation: methods (pill types it applies to: combined_pill | progestin_pill), missed (count; omit for a note), severity (ok | caution | urgent), optional pack_week (the week-1 rule) and the translated steps list.
hint.pelvicLevels: One level of the pelvic-floor program: week_from, hold_sec, rest_sec, reps and sets (plain numbers).
hint.alerts: Warning signs: severity (info | caution | urgent) and an optional translated cta label.
hint.scoreItems: Score questions: max (the highest answer value) and an optional domain code.
hint.tips: Tips: the title and body are the whole item. Usually no meta.
hint.menoScoreItems: Monthly menopause score question (title = question, body = hint): domain (somatic | psychological | urogenital — the subtotal it counts towards), max (4) and log: the related log-taxonomy slots ("category.param.item") used by patterns and the report.
hint.menoScoreBands: Score band on the monthly total (0–44): min and max, inclusive. Bands must not overlap and should cover 0–44.
hint.menoAlerts: Menopause warning signs: severity (caution | urgent), optional flags primary (the top card), emergency (call now), hrt (only for HRT users), hotline (a number, e.g. "115"), stages (peri | meno | post | unsure; omit = every stage) and a translated cta label.
hint.menoTips: Menopause tips and notes: placement (home | log | hot_flash | treatment | treatment_lifestyle | checkups | score), optional stages (peri | meno | post | unsure), weekly_goal + goal_unit (sessions | minutes) for lifestyle items, review_after_months for HRT.
hint.menoCheckupGroups: Sections of the menopause checkups board: checkups = the checkup type keys shown in this section, in order (see Checkup types).
hint.conditionPrograms: Condition program hub card (endo | pmdd | heavy_bleeding | pcos): logs = the translated «what you log» line.
hint.painTypes: Pain-diary «what kind of pain?» chips: the title is the chip. No meta.
hint.painAssociated: Pain-diary «along with» chips: optional log = the log-taxonomy slot ("category.param.item") the choice is stored in; without it the code is kept in the pain diary.
hint.pmddItems: PMDD daily questionnaire items, each scored 1 (not at all) … 6 (extreme). No meta.
hint.conditionAlerts: Condition program notes and alerts: severity (info | caution | urgent) and optional hotlines: [{number, label: translated}].
